content.overview: Every Producer Company must have its accounts internally audited by a chartered accountant as defined in the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949. The interval and manner of the internal audit are as specified in the Producer Company's articles.
content.glance: Section 378ZF requires internal audit of every Producer Company's accounts by a qualifying chartered accountant, at the interval and in the manner specified in its articles.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZF (Internal audit). Every Producer Company must have internal audit of its accounts carried out at the interval and in the manner specified in its articles, by a chartered accountant as defined in section 2(1)(b) of the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949. Section 378ZF does not itself specify a universal interval; the articles supply the interval and manner. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Mandatory internal audit
sections.body: Every Producer Company shall have internal audit of its accounts carried out.

sections.heading: Interval and manner
sections.body: The interval and manner of the internal audit are those specified in the Producer Company's articles.

sections.heading: Auditor qualification
sections.body: The internal audit is to be carried out by a chartered accountant as defined in section 2(1)(b) of the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949.

examples.title: Checking internal-audit compliance
examples.body: Verify that the Producer Company's accounts undergo internal audit, that the auditor meets the statutory chartered-accountant definition, and that the interval and manner match the company's articles.

hypotheticals.question: A Producer Company performs internal audits but follows a frequency not stated in its articles. What section 378ZF issue arises?
hypotheticals.analysis: Section 378ZF ties the interval and manner of internal audit to the Producer Company's articles. Check the applicable articles and compare the actual audit schedule and method with them; do not invent a universal statutory frequency.

distinctions.title: Internal audit and statutory auditor reporting
distinctions.left: Section 378ZF requires internal audit of the Producer Company's accounts, with interval and manner specified in the articles.
distinctions.right: Section 378ZG adds matters for the auditor to report on, without prejudice to section 143.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming section 378ZF fixes one universal audit interval for every Producer Company.
misconceptions.correction: The section leaves the interval and manner to the company's articles.

misconceptions.trap: Treating any auditor as satisfying the qualification requirement.
misconceptions.correction: The section specifies a chartered accountant as defined by the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949.

misconceptions.trap: Treating internal audit and the additional auditor reporting duties in section 378ZG as the same requirement.
misconceptions.correction: Keep the internal-audit obligation in section 378ZF distinct from the additional reporting matters in section 378ZG.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does section 378zf do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Every Producer Company has an internal audit of its accounts carried out, at such interval and in such manner as may be specified, by a chartered accountant.
